title: Senior Platform Engineer, ML Infrastructure
purpose: Stretch: explicitly requires Kubernetes and other infrastructure skills. The sample profile has Docker but never mentions Kubernetes, so no Kubernetes experience may be generated.
description:
About the role
Ironbark Cloud Systems runs GPU clusters for machine learning teams. We are hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own the Kubernetes platform that schedules model workloads for our customers.

Responsibilities
- Operate and scale multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters running GPU workloads
- Write Kubernetes operators and controllers in Golang
- Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm
- Run Kafka event pipelines and Prometheus monitoring
- Lead incident response for the platform

Requirements
- 5+ years of experience operating Kubernetes in production
- Strong programming skills in Golang
- Experience with Terraform and Helm
- Experience running Kafka in production
- Experience with Prometheus and Grafana
- Experience with Docker and container image builds
- Proficiency in Python for automation

Preferred qualifications
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- Experience with GPU scheduling
- Experience with AWS
- Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions
